statements.proposition: The repository's lint checks (ruff, per tox env 'ruff' and ruff.toml) pass at the head commit.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: tox 'ruff' env runs 'ruff check' with ruff.toml (ALL rules extended). Latest ruff 0.17.3 reports one finding, CPY001 (missing copyright notice) at line 1 of fallback.py, but the identical finding occurs on the base version of the file, so it is not introduced by the change and is a new-ruff-version effect; the project does not pin ruff. With ruff 0.13.3 (contemporary with the PR, Oct 2025) both the changed file and the whole repo pass. Labelled by the contemporary version; mypy/ty were not run since the statement says linting.
evidence: ruff 0.13.3: 'ruff check src/my/tests/location/fallback.py' -> All checks passed!; 'ruff check .' -> All checks passed!
ruff 0.17.3: 'ruff check src/my/tests/location/fallback.py' -> CPY001 at 1:1, 1 error; same single error with the base-commit (2bbf98a) version of the file
